impl.summary: Image to 3D now has a 'Refine detail · Hi3D 1.0' switch with a 512 / 1024 / 1536 choice. It is open-engine only. When it is on, the server runs two steps: the open model the user picked (Pixal3D, TRELLIS.2, Hunyuan3D 2.1 or TRELLIS.2 multi-view) builds the mesh, then Hi3D refines that mesh's geometry from the same photo (chain slot model3d). Both models are kept. A finished mesh also gets 'Refine this mesh' (with its price) and a 'Print-ready' export. The export writes an STL or 3MF in the browser, scaled to a height the user sets, Z up and standing on the bed, after a watertight check. Refined results say they are geometry only and show 'Powered by Hi3D 1.0' linked to http://hi3d.ai/, as the licence asks. The cloud engine says Refine runs on your GPU only (nobody hosts the open Hi3D; fal's hitem3d/hi3d/* endpoints are Hitem3D's closed product and none takes a mesh; Replicate has nothing). 'Paid APIs only' hides it. Accounts are refused with own-gpu-tool, like every 3D model. The open route uses T8star's community ComfyUI pack (Comfyui-Hi3d-T8 v0.5.1, MIT, in the ComfyUI Registry) with core SaveGLB, so the server's GLB finish takes the result as it does for other 3D models. No Fuobe pack or sidecar was needed: four community packs appeared after comfyui-oss-4 said there was none.

Hi3DModelLoader (models/Hi3D, CPU offload, flash attention) + LoadImage -> core BiRefNet RemoveBackground mask -> Hi3DLoadMesh -> Hi3DRefine -> SaveGLB. findings.title: Refine graph gives Hi3D the subject's mask the wrong way round, so the subject is cut out and the background is kept
findings.detail: Core RemoveBackground returns a foreground mask where 1 means the subject (comfy_extras/nodes_bg_removal.py: 'Generated foreground mask'; comfy/bg_removal_model.py returns sigmoid(BiRefNet)). T8's Hi3DRefine reads its optional MASK with 1 meaning transparent: image_to_pil sets alpha = (1 - mask) in comfy_nodes.py at the pinned commit 73848490, and docs/COMFYUI.md line 23 says 'MASK 的 1 表示透明'. Fuobe's own bg-remove-birefnet graph adds an InvertMask between RemoveBackground and JoinImageWithAlpha for this reason. As wired, every refine makes the object transparent and keeps the background as Hi3D's reference image. Hi3D uses the alpha to frame the subject (README line 157), so it is conditioned on the wrong pixels. tests/hi3d-refine.test.ts checks only the binding keys, not what the mask means.
findings.fix: Put core InvertMask between node 4 and Hi3DRefine.mask, or leave the mask out and feed an RGBA cut-out. Add a test that the mask passes through an InvertMask, or that it is absent.

findings.title: Graph always uses flash attention, but nothing installs flash-attn, so every run on a fresh HI3D=1 install fails
findings.where: mesh-refine-hi3d.json node 1 Hi3DModelLoader attention: 'flash'; scripts/comfy/install-comfyui.sh HI3D block
findings.detail: The HI3D=1 block installs only the pack's requirements.txt. At the pinned commit that file has numpy, trimesh, spconv-cu126, triton and others, but no flash-attn. At run time hi3d_native/runtime.py attention('flash') does 'import flash_attn' and otherwise raises RuntimeError('缺少 FlashAttention，请在 Hi3D 加载器选择 sdpa'). The pack's docs make sdpa the default and say flash is only for an existing compatible FlashAttention. So following Fuobe's own install steps gives a refine that always fails, with a raw Chinese error. attention also isn't a binding, so the server can't change it. The implementer raised this in 'left' but shipped the setting that fails.
findings.fix: Set attention to 'sdpa' in the graph, or add a binding that defaults to sdpa. Alternatively, install a pinned flash-attn in the HI3D block and say so in scripts/comfy/README.md.

findings.title: Refine detail is silently dropped when the image-to-3D step waits on an earlier step (Canvas 3D node fed by an image node; Assist plan text-to-image then image-to-3d)
findings.where: src/server/generations.ts createGenerations: the createRefinedModel branch requires !opts.dependsOn; src/server/canvas.ts ~628-631 passes dependsOn for upstream nodes in the same run
findings.detail: Two common flows hit this. One is a Canvas 3D node with the new 'Refine detail · Hi3D 1.0' control, wired from an image node that runs in the same pass. The other is an Assist or MCP plan where a still feeds an open image-to-3d job that sets mesh_resolution. In both, the 3D step is created with dependsOn, so the refine branch is skipped and only the coarse model is made. hi3dRefine stays in params.extra and goes into the coarse graph's values, where nothing reads it. There is no refine and no error, and the toast and the control both say a refine will run. Tests cover the no-dependency case only (tests/hi3d-refine.test.ts 'open:' and the Assist 'set the refine step…' case starts from a ready photo).
findings.fix: When dependsOn is set, chain the Hi3D step after the coarse step with two slots: model3d from the coarse step, and the photo from the upstream image step. Or refuse with a clear message. Add a test for each of the two flows.

findings.title: The GPU pre-flight can't see the Hi3D weights it lists
findings.where: workflows/comfyui/requirements.json files Hi3D/* (presence 'list' for the safetensors, 'unobservable' for the JSON files)
findings.detail: models/Hi3D is not a folder ComfyUI registers: the pack reads it directly through folder_paths.models_dir, and folder_names_and_paths has a 'hi3d' entry only when extra_model_paths.yaml adds one. So a 'list' presence check never finds the files, and the board can't show 'Image to 3D, refined' as Ready even when everything is installed. The implementer noted this in 'left'.
findings.fix: Mark these files 'unobservable' (or 'loader') so they don't read as missing. Or have install-comfyui.sh register a hi3d folder in extra_model_paths.yaml.
